decision_summary: Visionary, Builder, and Guardian approve v0.6.35 Selective Escalation Calibration with explicit authority and evidence-only boundaries.
rationale: The slice fills the binary routing gap using existing calibration inputs, while Guardian conditions prevent automatic authority, causal blame, surveillance, and count-based quality claims.
recommendation: Implement and release the narrow calibration-report extension after full fixture and AOF verification.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, and governance owners
expected_user_reaction: Users can explain why a case was routed and what evidence remains unresolved.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add policy, decision, assessment, example, verifier, fixtures, plain-language guide, and roadmap.
